caption:
Every automated kill switch has strict operational limits. No broker-level block trading API exists except at Dhan, so enforcement relies on a re-fire loop that squares off trades within seconds rather than preventing them outright. Market orders on illiquid strikes can slip, and server downtime pauses monitoring.
